title: bierre capabilities
description: Response body of GET /api/capabilities, served by bierre/webapp/server.py in both run modes. The front-end fetches it once at boot; every account-shaped affordance is rendered only when its capability is true, and absent (not disabled) otherwise. Feature flags stay free-valued on purpose so a hosted deployment can report false for a phase that has not shipped yet; only the structural invariants of each mode are constrained here. One rule cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and is asserted by the capabilities test instead: default_locale must be a member of locales.

mode.description: Deployment shape. Comes from config, never from a guess.

auth.description: Whether a sign-in flow exists. Local mode never shows a login wall.

accounts.description: Whether bierre-ca owns identity for this deployment.

auth_methods.description: Credentials the backend can actually service right now. A method absent from this list renders no button at all.

accounts_base.description: Path prefix the webapp proxies to bierre-ca, or null when no account service exists.

email_digest.description: Whether outbound digest mail is available. Local mode gets a 'Check for new papers' button instead.

history.description: Which HistoryRepository is bound. A single-choice switch, never a fallback list: two live backends would save every run twice.

history_retention.description: Server-side retention ceiling, or null when history is local and bounded only by disk.

max_subscriptions.description: Active subscriptions allowed per user. 0 disables the affordance; the hard ceiling is 10.

profile_write.description: Whether this client may create, edit or delete profiles. Write authority is mode == local or an authenticated request.

ai_profile_generation.description: How profile generation is paid for: the user's own key or a hosted bierre-ca under an anonymous rate limit, versus their account.

shared_api_keys.description: Whether the deployment supplies search-source API keys. False means bring your own or run keyless.

locales.description: Locales with a shipped string catalogue.

default_locale.description: Locale used before a user preference is known. Must be a member of locales.

legal_urls.description: Where the footer and the signup consent line point.

allOf.title: local mode has no account service at all
hosted mode always has identity and server-side history
a credential the UI can render implies a sign-in flow
